subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: May Day or the International Workers' Day is observed to commemorate the struggle and sacrifice of the working people. Their main demand was eight-hour workday. The day, May 1, is a public holiday all over the world. The workers had to work long hours since the Industrial Revolution. So they went on strike on May 1st in 1886 and were attacked by the police. One striker was killed and many got injured. It is for their sacrifice workers today enjoy better working condition. Part−B : Writing Test See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 196
